objective: Prepare a deterministic public Solana Devnet test proving that the deployed browser records one submitted reissue fulfillment, survives an intentionally failed hosted reconciliation in the same tab, and resumes without a second fulfillment submission.

deployment_acknowledgment.interpretation: The completed deployment receipt is acknowledged as accepted evidence. This creates no new operational authority.

historical_artifact_baseline.reason: The browser currently models one reissue threshold and does not promote the replacement key into a reusable public identity card; a second reissue on this artifact would not test the intended first-reissue UX.

selected_test_shape.fixture: one fresh disposable artifact with new test identity IDs
selected_test_shape.browser_originator: The user-controlled Phantom wallet acts as the disposable originator so the production A-side browser fulfillment path can sign directly without disclosing or importing the preserved Codex A credential.
selected_test_shape.operator_recipient: One new disposable local recipient wallet and encryption identity performs the recipient and reissue-request roles.
selected_test_shape.identity_boundary: The fixture identities are test-only and must not replace test-codex-a or test-vrondelli.
selected_test_shape.interruption_mechanism: Before fulfillment, browser request blocking targets only https://kep.cyberalchemylab.com/v1/reissues/*/fulfill. Solana Devnet RPC remains reachable. The blocked hosted request must occur only after the browser has stored the submitted signature in sessionStorage.
selected_test_shape.resume_mechanism: Remove the single URL block, refresh the same tab without clearing sessionStorage, and select Resume saved fulfillment. The browser must verify the stored signature and perform hosted reconciliation without wallet approval or a second Solana submission.
selected_test_shape.durability_claim_limit: same-tab sessionStorage refresh only; tab closure, browser restart, storage clearing, and cross-device recovery are excluded

runnable_product_work: construct one fresh disposable fixture and exact public identity cards
construct and validate one two-phase operator/browser execution envelope
freeze the exact artifact, request, account, wallet, key-version, submission-count, endpoint-block, and reconciliation assertions
rehearse the interruption using mocked HTTP and RPC without any hosted or Devnet effect

operational_support.task: confirm the deployed bundle, health, program ID, Devnet genesis hash, and finalized balances immediately before execution
configure one browser URL-blocking rule for the exact fulfillment endpoint and prove Solana RPC remains reachable
preserve local attempt journals and public cards

causal_blockers: the fresh disposable recipient identity, encryption keypair, wallet and exact fingerprint do not yet exist
the user-controlled originator public identity card and fresh artifact do not yet exist
no exact live execution candidate or digest-bound authorization exists

hosted_write_breakdown: reconcile the exact finalized fulfillment after resume
planned_effect_budget.intentionally_blocked_request_effect: client-side network failure before the hosted server receives the fulfillment write
planned_effect_budget.wallet_approvals: exactly the approvals required for the disposable originator's three Solana submissions; the resume step requires none

required_observations: the fulfillment transaction signature is stored in sessionStorage before the hosted failure
the error remains visible and identifies inspection-before-retry posture
after same-tab refresh, Resume saved fulfillment is available
resume inspects the exact stored finalized signature
no second wallet prompt or fulfillment transaction occurs
the hosted state advances exactly from revision 1 to revision 2
the originator and recipient owner set, epoch, policy, ciphertext and plaintext commitment remain unchanged
the recipient envelope changes to key version 2
an exact hosted replay returns the committed result without appending another state event
the recipient opens the artifact with the replacement private key
stop_conditions: any deployment, identity, balance, network, program, artifact, owner, epoch, policy, ciphertext, key-version, account or digest mismatch
the URL block affects Solana RPC or any endpoint other than the exact hosted fulfillment route
the fulfillment signature is not durably present in same-tab sessionStorage before interruption
any submission or hosted write has ambiguous effect
any second fulfillment wallet prompt or Solana submission is requested
finality or exact post-state is unavailable
forbidden_effects: reuse of the historical artifact for the new reissue
credential disclosure or import of the preserved Codex A key into a browser wallet
Mainnet, paid RPC fallback, airdrop, funding, consideration transfer, or ownership change
more than four Solana submissions or seven successful hosted writes
automatic retry, automatic rollback, deployment, publication, release, or cleanup

next_candidate.required_kind: fresh disposable fixture and non-effectful execution-envelope construction
next_candidate.minimum_authority: local key generation, mocked tests, read-only hosted and Devnet inspection, and exact local evidence writes only
next_candidate.not_yet_authorized: fixture hosted writes, wallet approvals, RPC submissions, Devnet transactions, controlled interruption, or reconciliation

external_effect: none beyond the recorded public read-only artifact snapshot
claim_limit: Planning candidate only. It acknowledges the completed deployment and defines a live-test path but does not authorize fixture construction, hosted writes, wallet use, RPC submission, Devnet transactions, interruption, reconciliation, publication, or release.
